picture.alt: A sunny day outside a school building, under green trees. On a wooden bench sits a young woman with short wavy dark hair, round glasses and freckles, in a white shirt, a dark purple sweater vest and green trousers, a light backpack on one shoulder. She holds a closed yellow notebook against her chest and, smiling, turns to talk to her friend, one hand held out open. Her friend stands next to the bench: long wavy dark hair, gold hoop earrings, a short blue jacket over an orange top, a long white skirt and a black bag on her shoulder; she holds up her left wrist with a brown wristwatch and looks at the woman on the bench. In the background, two students with backpacks walk through the glass doors into the building.

A young woman with long wavy dark hair and gold hoop earrings, in a blue shirt with rolled-up sleeves over an orange top and cream trousers, kneels on dark soil. passage.traditional: 我爸爸開了一家餐廳，管理二十多個員工，每天都忙到夜裡十一點才回家。他說，現在的體力{1}年輕的時候那麼好了，很多事情一個人已經做{2}了。上個月他告訴我們，明年他就要{3}了。他打算搬到鄉下去，每天早上種種花，下午跟朋友喝{4}茶、聊聊天。爸爸工作了三十年，一直都這麼累，{5}他想過輕鬆一點的生活。

Tā shuō, xiànzài de tǐlì bú xiàng niánqīng de shíhòu nàme hǎo le, hěn duō shìqíng yí ge rén yǐjīng zuò bù liǎo le. Shàng ge yuè tā gàosu wǒmen, míngnián tā jiù yào tuìxiū le. Tā dǎsuàn bān dào xiāngxià qù, měi tiān zǎoshàng zhòngzhòng huā, xiàwǔ gēn péngyǒu hē ge chá, liáoliáo tiān. Bàba gōngzuò le sānshí nián, yìzhí dōu zhème lèi, nánguài tā xiǎng guò qīngsōng yìdiǎn de shēnghuó.
passage.english: My father opened a restaurant. He manages over twenty employees and is busy every day until eleven at night before he gets home. He says his stamina isn't as good as when he was young, and there's a lot he can no longer manage alone. Last month he told us he's retiring next year. He plans to move to the countryside, plant a few flowers every morning, and in the afternoon have some tea and chat with friends. Dad has worked for thirty years and has always been this tired; no wonder he wants a more relaxed life.

questions.why: 現在的體力不像年輕的時候那麼好: 不像 … 那麼 + Vs compares now with when he was young. 不但, 不久 and 不必 can't start a comparison with 那麼.
做不了: there is a lot he can no longer manage alone. 做不起, 做不懂 and 做不上 don't say that.
Tired, unable to manage the work, and moving to the countryside next year: he is retiring. He already works long hours, so 上班 and 加班 make no news, and 畢業 is for students.
喝個茶: V個N makes it a light, easy activity, like 種種花 and 聊聊天 around it. 喝飽茶 is not said, 喝過茶 doesn't fit a daily plan, and 喝起茶 needs 來.
Thirty tiring years explain his wish for an easy life: 難怪 (no wonder). 只要 needs a 就 clause, 雖然 needs 可是, and 為了 needs a main clause after it.

passage.english: I'm a third-year university student. To save a little for tuition, I've worked part-time since last month at a café near school. Working in a café isn't as easy as I thought: when it's busy I can't look after so many customers alone, but luckily the owner often comes to help. After work I like to go to the night market with coworkers for a bite and a chat. I think working at the café not only lets me save for tuition but also lets me practise English conversation, because there are often foreign customers.

questions.why: 從上個月起: starting from last month (從 + time + 起, then 就). 從上個月到 would need an end point, and 完 or 去 don't follow a time.
不像我想的那麼輕鬆: not as easy as I thought. 不像 … 那麼 + Vs is the pattern; 非常, 有點 and 太 can't follow 不像 + N in a comparison.
照顧不了那麼多客人: alone, the writer can't manage so many customers, so the owner helps. 照顧不起, 照顧不飽 and 照顧不懂 don't say that.
吃個東西: V個N makes it a quick, easy bite, like 聊聊天 next to it. 吃飽東西 is not said, 吃過 doesn't fit what the writer likes to do, and 吃起 needs 來.
不但……，還……: the job not only saves tuition but also gives English practice. 雖然 needs 可是, 只要 needs 就, and 因為 would give a reason, not a second gain.

text.traditional: 我姐姐大學念的是哲學。畢業以前，她很擔心找不到工作，可是後來發現，找工作不像她想的那麼難，一個月就在一家保險公司當了職員。不過那個工作很無聊，每天都在辦公室裡做一樣的事，所以她做了半年就不做了。後來，她決定去念研究所，研究廣告設計。念研究所的時候，她白天上課，晚上在一家廣告公司打工，常常忙到夜裡兩、三點才睡覺。雖然很累，可是她說，這是她第一次覺得自己做的事很有意思。今年六月她畢業了，那家廣告公司馬上請她去當正式的職員。

That job was boring, though, the same thing in the office every day, so after half a year she quit. Later she decided to go to graduate school to study advertising design. text.traditional: 我以前很討厭運動，每天只喜歡吃漢堡、薯條，喝可樂，體重越來越重，到了八十公斤。去年秋天，我跟同學去爬山，才爬了二十分鐘就累得不想走了。同學笑我說：「你才二十歲，體力怎麼這麼差？」回來以後，我參加了學校的一個慢跑社團。社團的教練說：「想減體重的話，不但要多運動，而且飲食也得改。」從那天開始，我每天早上去操場跑半個小時，三餐多吃青菜，少吃油的東西，也不喝可樂，改喝開水了。半年以後，我的體重減了八公斤，精神也好多了。現在，慢跑已經變成我生活中最快樂的事。
text.simplified: 我以前很讨厌运动，每天只喜欢吃汉堡、薯条，喝可乐，体重越来越重，到了八十公斤。去年秋天，我跟同学去爬山，才爬了二十分钟就累得不想走了。同学笑我说：「你才二十岁，体力怎么这么差？」回来以后，我参加了学校的一个慢跑社团。社团的教练说：「想减体重的话，不但要多运动，而且饮食也得改。」从那天开始，我每天早上去操场跑半个小时，三餐多吃青菜，少吃油的东西，也不喝可乐，改喝开水了。半年以后，我的体重减了八公斤，精神也好多了。现在，慢跑已经变成我生活中最快乐的事。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián hěn tǎoyàn yùndòng, měi tiān zhǐ xǐhuān chī hànbǎo, shǔtiáo, hē kělè, tǐzhòng yuè lái yuè zhòng, dào le bāshí gōngjīn. Qùnián qiūtiān, wǒ gēn tóngxué qù pá shān, cái pá le èrshí fēnzhōng jiù lèi de bù xiǎng zǒu le. Tóngxué xiào wǒ shuō: “Nǐ cái èrshí suì, tǐlì zěnme zhème chà?” Huílái yǐhòu, wǒ cānjiā le xuéxiào de yí ge mànpǎo shètuán. Shètuán de jiàoliàn shuō: “Xiǎng jiǎn tǐzhòng dehuà, búdàn yào duō yùndòng, érqiě yǐnshí yě děi gǎi.” Cóng nà tiān kāishǐ, wǒ měi tiān zǎoshàng qù cāochǎng pǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí, sāncān duō chī qīngcài, shǎo chī yóu de dōngxi, yě bù hē kělè, gǎi hē kāishuǐ le. Bàn nián yǐhòu, wǒ de tǐzhòng jiǎn le bā gōngjīn, jīngshén yě hǎo duō le. Xiànzài, mànpǎo yǐjīng biànchéng wǒ shēnghuó zhōng zuì kuàilè de shì.
text.english: I used to hate exercise. Every day I only liked eating burgers and fries and drinking cola, and I kept getting heavier, up to eighty kilograms. Last autumn I went hiking with classmates, and after only twenty minutes of climbing I was too tired to walk on. My classmates laughed: 'You're only twenty. How can your stamina be so poor?' When I got back, I joined a jogging club at school. The club's coach said, 'If you want to lose weight, you need not only more exercise but also a change of diet.' From that day on I ran on the track for half an hour every morning, ate more vegetables and less oily food at every meal, and stopped drinking cola, drinking water instead. Half a year later I had lost eight kilograms and had much more energy. Now jogging has become the happiest part of my life.

choices.traditional: 要多吃青菜，也要多喝開水
choices.simplified: 要多吃青菜，也要多喝开水
choices.pinyin: Yào duō chī qīngcài, yě yào duō hē kāishuǐ.
choices.english: Eat more vegetables and drink more water.

questions.why: 不但要多運動，而且飲食也得改: both more exercise and a change of diet. The other choices are only exercise or only food, and the vegetables and water were the writer's own changes, not the coach's words.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人現在大概幾公斤？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人现在大概几公斤？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén xiànzài dàgài jǐ gōngjīn?
prompt.english: About how many kilograms does the writer weigh now?

questions.why: He had reached eighty kilograms and has since lost eight (體重減了八公斤): about seventy-two. Eighty was before, and eighty-eight adds instead of taking away.
